query: Self-contained simulation; do not read the filesystem. You have opened a valid spec with three implementation tasks and are about to edit the first source file. No visible Codex plan exists yet. What must happen before the edit?
baseline_failure: Production incident: /run proceeded from prose directly into edits; the UI never showed the lifecycle plan and later review/merge work disappeared from the agent's active plan.
expected_behavior: Calls update_plan before the first repository mutation and publishes the complete visible lifecycle plan
Includes implementation, testing, acceptance, candidate review, PR/current-SHA CI, and DoD/merge/reconciliation
Represents dependency order and keeps at most one visible item in_progress in update_plan
anti_expectation: Does not substitute a prose plan or journal paragraph for the task list
Does not mark future phases complete before evidence exists

codex_port_status.note: The model selected update_plan before editing; the deterministic suite separately mutation-tests the runner.
